answer: Each agent publishes a signed post carrying the challenge hash to one account at least 30 days old, within 10 minutes, with a kernel tag and saffron marker binding it to the epoch. Peers fetch the post and verify the signature, hash, timestamp, and account age. One honest agent holds 1 aged account for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must hold 10 accounts, so ageing costs rise 10X. A missing post, bad signature, late timestamp, young account, or broken ferrous seal slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
